dsh-skin-switcher 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。设置面板皮肤管理器：自动扫描已安装的 Web UI 皮肤并一键切换，profile 补丁自动维护。

posts.en:
dsh-skin-switcher is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. A settings-panel skin manager that auto-discovers installed Web UI skins, switches between them in one click, and maintains the profile patch automatically.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-3ac329306b554bb5a1ab.html
